Share your details with a tap. Free, with no account and no internet: nothing leaves your phone until you share it. The other person doesn\'t need any app.

All your cards, photos, the Met list and your settings are removed from this phone. This can\'t be undone. Make a backup first if you might want them back.
Answer taps when Tilde is closed
Off: taps only share while Tilde is open, so nothing is shared from your pocket by accident. On: your phone also shares when Tilde is closed, as long as the screen is on and the phone is unlocked.
